project.name: Distributed Word Count: mapreduce-worker
project.description: The map phase, hosted as its own dedicated worker JVM (TIER_2): tokenizes and counts one chunk of input lines at a time, dispatched to it over Gimlé's own fabric ServiceRegistry. Deployed with multiple replicas, each real chunk lands on whichever replica the fabric's own load balancer currently picks -- genuine parallel distributed computation, not a simulation of it.
